items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I know who she is she’s a club singer. A good singer. Broadway and cabaret I think.

ctx.x: Great to hear that about him.

He’s 74 and I shouldn’t comment about his health except to say I don’t think he’s doing so well. And everybody says, “Well if he’s got a breathing problem, how can he play the trumpet?” Well if you look at the trumpet, the bell is this big around but there’s not a column of air coming out. The column of air is this big around going into the mouthpiece. So that isn’t the problem. It’s just feeling well enough to go out there and put joy into it. And how he does it I don’t know, he just gets up there, like last…
The future’s in some good hands there.
